response.rationale: The product is given its legal name as 'Mature cheddar cheese', which is a customary and descriptive name for this type of food and not merely a brand or fancy name. Regarding QUID, the ingredient 'MILK' is both emphasised (uppercase) and appears in the name of the food ('cheddar cheese' is a cheese made from milk), and its percentage (98%) is declared in the ingredient list. This satisfies the requirement for a quantitative declaration where the ingredient is essential to characterise the food and is emphasised.

citations.quoted_span: foods consisting of a single ingredient, where: (i) the name of the food is identical to the ingredient name; or (ii) the name of the food enables the nature of the ingredient to be clearly identified.
